independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: Parsel naturally separates utility and XPath support, CSS translation, and selector execution. Selector.css and Selector.xpath consume both upstream contracts, making stale translator or extension assumptions observable in public tests. Inclusion is conditional on explicitly documenting that the setup overlay wires the still-unfinished set_xpathfunc and has_class functions for collection; an older audit rejected this wiring under a stricter bootstrap interpretation, so human adjudication should resolve that policy conflict.
